fragments.derivationNote: Pinned OHM 1689 reconstruction accepted only after exact-relation licensing check, distributed spatial controls and primary-document corroboration. It is a generalized historical reconstruction, not a surveyed state border.

historicalDate.original: 1689 — extent of Russian expansion; conservative year-end anchor

baseStates.notes: The OHM source is year-precision, so coverage begins only at 1689-12. The polygon excludes Azov, matching the pre-1696 state; therefore it is conservatively bounded through 1695-12 and is not stretched across the Azov acquisition.
